text:
anya: Quick pre-launch sync for checkout-routing.v3 — we need a conservative rollout for the customer-driven payment checkout changes.
kevin: Outline? single-AZ canary then regional ramp?
anya: Yes. Draft: Phase 0: darklaunch + internal-only traffic for 24h. Phase 1: AZ canary (us-west-2) 0.5% traffic for 45m. Phase 2: cross-region warmup (us-west-2 + us-east-1) 3% for 4h. Phase 3: staged ramp to 20% over 24h, then conditional ramp to 100% over 48h.
marcus: Kill-switch rules: auto-rollback if error_rate > 1.8x baseline for 3m OR p95 latency delta > 150ms for 5m. Immediate rollback if any customer report of payment failure impacting >1 customer (manual tier).
jordan: For metric gating, require payment_success_rate non-inferior (within 0.25%) and downstream funnel conversion CI before >20%. I can wire quickchecks to the rollout pipeline.
linda: Sales asked for early access to a cohort of enterprise customers. We need per-tenant overrides and a fast "pause" toggle in the admin UI.
kevin: Note: per-tenant override will be implemented via the flag service with tenant priority. Example rule (pseudo):
```json
{"flag":"checkout.v3_enabled","rules":[{"type":"tenant","id":"ENT-900","pct":100},{"type":"region","id":"us-west-2","pct":0.5}]}
```
marcus: Ops request: two observability watch windows next week (08:00-10:00 PT, 13:00-15:00 PT). Pager path: oncall -> infra lead -> eng-sre. Also request a manual rollback playbook link.
anya: I'll author runbook RB-2026-90 and list named approvers for each window. Auto-postmortem if rollback occurs.
kevin: Fallback: on automated abort route traffic to checkout.v2 and tag the flag state "canary-failed". Prevent automatic re-enable for 12h.
jordan: Also schedule a 10-day A/B experiment at 15% on non-payment flows to track hidden regressions (search, recommendations). Experiment flags must include tags for rollup.
linda: For platinum customers, provide a 24h grace/remove window and a visible banner in console when their tenant is in opt-in. Security review required for the UI change.
marcus: Preflight checklist: canary test suite green, smoke test scripts run against canary, dashboards (p50/p95/p99, error_rate, success_rate, per-tenant failures), alerts created, rollout inhibit if infra CPU >75% or API error budget low.
kevin: CI guard: block >20% unless sample size >= 10k requests and statistical test passes. We'll wire that into the CD pipeline.
anya: Owners: ops owns Phase 1 go/no-go, product+eng sign Phase 2. Approvers will be in RB-2026-90.
opsbot: Note: automated rollback actions are ready to be wired to the kill conditions. Will post automation logs into #incidents when triggered. :gear:
linda: I'll send the enterprise CSV tonight and confirm security review timeline.
jordan: I'll publish the experiment dashboard and add the CI gate by EOD tomorrow.
marcus: I'll create the alert runbook entries and add automation to flip the flag and route traffic to checkout.v2 on abort.
kevin: I'll open the feature-flag PR and the admin console change; will request security review.
anya: Plan posted as canonical. Targeting canary start on Tue 09:30 PT. Ping in-thread for any updates. :white_check_mark:
